query:
SELECT 
  p.id as payable_id,
  p.purchaseOrderId,
  p.supplierId,
  partners.name as supplier_name,
  p.totalAmount,
  p.paidAmount,
  (p.totalAmount - p.paidAmount) as pending,
  p.status,
  p.createdAt
FROM payables p
LEFT JOIN partners ON partners.id = p.supplierId
WHERE p.status = 'PENDENTE' OR (p.totalAmount - p.paidAmount) > 0
ORDER BY pending;
